close_reason: Opinion: #[allow(deprecated)] attribute is self-explanatory. No comment needed.
description: The #[allow(deprecated)] on jmap_error_all_constructors_serialize has no comment explaining why the deprecated constructor is intentionally exercised. A contributor who sees this suppression in six months may wonder if it was laziness or intentional. Suggested addition: a comment on the unknown_capability() call inside the vec\! like '// intentionally testing deprecated constructor for serialization coverage' so the purpose is clear without reading the test name.
title: #[allow(deprecated)] in test lacks inline explanation
